note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). B-52H Stratofortress: AGM-183A ARRW, the US hypersonic missile tested on the B-52H, as two choices of +200 each (dev.39; dev.37 had 2x on the wings for +300, dev.38 4x on the AGM-86C wing pylon for +400, which looked exactly like the ALCM). Bomb bay: 2x AGM-183A ARRW (+200), on the bay mount the 8x AGM-86C uses. Wing pylons: 2x AGM-183A ARRW (+200), one per wing pylon, on the mounts the wing options use. Both use the Kinzhal model (the game has no ARRW model and no pylon-only ALCM model), so 4 ARRWs with both choices. The ARRW is a renamed copy of the MiG-31K Kh-47M2 Kinzhal HE (round 455: damage 70, penetration 250, range 5000; weapon 610; pylon 836); the MiG-31K Kinzhal is unchanged. Not yet run in a game. dev.41: the ARRW turret-weapon rows take WeaponChannel 1 from the B-52's AGM-86C row (902); dev.39 copied the MiG-31K's channel 0, and the B-52 had no order to fire it (Osama: no button, no bombing run or precision strike).
name: AGM-183A ARRW
